newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal airport operator seen privatising H2 1998.
newsitem.headline: Portugal airport operator seen privatising H2 1998.

text.p: The privatisation of Portuguese airport operator ANA-Aeroportos e Navegacao Aerea is expected during the second half of 1998, according to a Public Works Ministry document.

"A valuation of the company could take place in the first half of 1998, and so the privatisation operation could take place in the second half next year," read the document, made available to Reuters after its presentation to the cabinet.
Consultancies chosen by ANA -- BFE Servicos Financeiro and BZW -- are studying a restructuring and privatisation plan. They are expected to finish the task by November.
